evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Delivered as a constitutive operational creed — an identity-level rule equating unrehearsed rollbacks with nonexistence, stated with permanence and no hedging.
The document performs the settling by labeling what follows as decisions — ratification language recording that the cadence is now settled and load-bearing.
Records the settled cadence as a committed operational rule under the 'Key decisions' header — performed ratification of a concrete recurring commitment.
Assigns ownership as part of the decision record — the act of naming an owner performs the settling, making the commitment load-bearing.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that unrehearsed readiness is indistinguishable from not having the capability at all?
